Re-homed from the BDK-343 btc-prague branch, where deck_settings_v1 lived in bmc-widget-protocol and was bound by a settings widget. Here it is a standalone protocol bound by the settings-tray layer-shell overlay. The dismiss request is dropped: hide is owned by deck_screen_edge_v1.

interface.name: deck_settings_v1
interface.description: Lightweight compositor-relayed IPC for the settings-tray overlay to control system state it must not touch directly. The target platform (OpenWrt/ARMv7) has no D-Bus/PipeWire/UPower; bmc owns the hardware drivers, so the overlay relays control through the compositor's Wayland connection. Only the settings-tray overlay binds this interface.

request.name: set_brightness
request.description: Request a display brightness change. Value is 0-100. bmc applies it night-mode-aware and reports the effective value back via brightness.

request.name: reconfigure_wifi
request.description: Request the compositor to put the device into WiFi setup mode: an open access point plus captive portal, the same flow used for factory-default setup. One-way; the device leaves setup mode on its own once a network is configured from the phone. Progress is reported via wifi_ap.

event.name: brightness
event.description: Report the effective display brightness. Emitted once when the overlay binds, and again whenever the effective brightness changes, including the night-mode value while night mode is active. Value is 0-100.

event.name: wifi_ap
event.description: Report the WiFi setup access-point SSID. A non-empty SSID means setup mode is active and the user can join this network from their phone; an empty string means setup mode is inactive. Emitted once on bind and again whenever the setup state changes.

arg.name: ssid
arg.summary: setup AP SSID, empty when inactive
